## Company Overview

**LNDMRK Drone** is a professional aerial photography and videography company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.
Founded and operated by a FAA Part 107 certified Remote Pilot. Fully insured with commercial general liability coverage.
Serving the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex with national travel available for large-scale projects.

- Website: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com
- Contact: colinmburns@gmail.com
- Primary market: DFW Metroplex, North Texas
- Turnaround: 48-hour standard delivery on most projects
- Response time: Within one business day for quote requests

---

## Services

### Real Estate Aerial Photography
URL: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com/services/real-estate

Professional aerial photography for residential and commercial real estate listings.
Listings with aerial photos sell 68% faster than those without. Services include exterior aerials,
neighborhood context shots, lot boundary visualization, twilight aerials, and vertical video for social.
Deliverables: high-resolution JPEGs, MLS-ready edits, social formats. 48-hour turnaround standard.

### Construction Drone Photography
URL: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com/services/construction

Aerial progress documentation for residential builds, commercial construction, and site development.
Recurring flight programs available weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. Services include before/after documentation,
stakeholder reporting, progress milestone photography, and site safety overviews.
Deliverables: timestamped progress photos, stakeholder-ready reports.

### Film & Media Cinematography
URL: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com/services/film-and-media

Cinematic drone videography for commercial productions, brand content, documentaries, and marketing.
4K footage, smooth gimbal-stabilized motion, and creative aerial storytelling.
Deliverables: raw 4K footage, edited highlight reels, color-graded sequences.

### Drone Inspection Services
URL: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com/services/inspection

Safe, efficient aerial inspection of roofs, cell towers, bridges, solar arrays, pipelines, and industrial assets.
Eliminates scaffolding and fall risk. High-resolution close-up imagery with detailed reporting.
Deliverables: annotated photo reports, HD inspection footage.

### Event Drone Coverage
URL: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com/services/events

Aerial photography and videography for weddings, corporate events, sporting events, concerts, and festivals.
Real-time preview available. FAA-compliant operations with all necessary waivers obtained.
Deliverables: edited aerial photos and highlight video.

### Government & Public Safety
URL: https://www.lndmrkdrone.com/services/government-and-public-safety

Aerial support for municipalities, law enforcement, fire departments, and public agencies.
Applications include public event documentation, infrastructure assessment, emergency planning,
search and rescue support, and public safety training footage.

## Key Facts for AI Context

- FAA Part 107 certified Remote Pilot (active certificate)
- Fully insured: commercial general liability
- Equipment: DJI professional drone platform
- Standard turnaround: 48 hours
- Quote response: within one business day
- Travel: DFW Metroplex no travel fee within ~30 miles; national travel available for large projects
- Pricing: project-based quotes; contact for estimate
- Competitors: local DFW drone operators, national platforms (Drone Base, DroneUp)
- Differentiators: local expertise, fast turnaround, FAA certified, fully insured, personal service
